description: List every tag defined in the company, with each tag's ID, normalized name and color. Use it to reuse existing tag names before tagging contacts, or to find a tagId.

companyId.description: Company ID to list tags for. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: list_tags

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_tags` MCP tool.

changeInProgress.description: Present only while a large rename or merge is still moving contacts: kind (rename or merge), fromName, toName, tagId and, for a merge, sourceTagId. Other renames, merges and deletes are refused until it is gone. stopped is true when it failed before finishing and needs support to finish it.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

tags.description: List of tag records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
